description: Implementation of QuicBufferedPacketStore class managing buffered QUIC packets, including packet buffering, expiration, and TLS handshake extraction.

classes.name: ConnectionExpireAlarm
classes.description: Alarm delegate class that triggers expiration timeout handling in QuicBufferedPacketStore.

methods.name: EnqueuePacket
methods.description: Buffers a packet for a specific connection, handling CHLO prioritization and buffer limits.

methods.name: HasBufferedPackets
methods.description: Checks if there are buffered packets for a given connection ID.

methods.name: HasChlosBuffered
methods.description: Checks if any CHLO packets are buffered.

methods.name: DeliverPackets
methods.description: Retrieves and removes buffered packets for a specific connection ID.

methods.name: DiscardPackets
methods.description: Discards buffered packets for a specific connection ID.

methods.name: DiscardAllPackets
methods.description: Clears all buffered packets and cancels expiration alarms.

methods.name: OnExpirationTimeout
methods.description: Handles expiration of old buffered packets based on connection lifespan.

methods.name: MaybeSetExpirationAlarm
methods.description: Sets the expiration alarm if not already set.

methods.name: ShouldNotBufferPacket
methods.description: Determines if new packets should be buffered based on store capacity and connection type.

methods.name: DeliverPacketsForNextConnection
methods.description: Delivers buffered packets for the next connection with a CHLO.

methods.name: HasChloForConnection
methods.description: Checks if a specific connection has a buffered CHLO.

methods.name: IngestPacketForTlsChloExtraction
methods.description: Processes a packet for TLS handshake extraction, returning ALPNs, SNI, and other info.
